page: Amazon Web Services c7gd.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by 64 dedicated physical cores of the ARM64 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 processor running at 2.6 GHz. It features 128 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. The instance is built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with Geekbench multi-core and software compilation tests scoring in the top 10% tier. Memory performance is notable, with Passmark memory scores in the top 10% and large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaching 276.53 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations both rank in the top 25%, demonstrating high throughput for data-intensive tasks. However, single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores remain in the middle 50% tier, and small-model text generation shows weaker relative performance.

The ARM64 architecture and dedicated core allocation offer high resource density and power efficiency, making this instance a cost-effective choice for multi-threaded workloads compared to traditional x86 alternatives. The combination of high-speed local NVMe storage and strong memory bandwidth makes the c7gd.16xlarge highly suitable for high-performance computing, software compilation, database hosting, Redis caching, and static web serving.
